title: Product list (current codes)
summary: Static product master of the Valdena Gelato sales system, listing the current product codes, product names and categories (about 64 rows per catalog). It holds no historical or pre-2024 codes and no mapping to them, so it cannot on its own support the N2 code crosswalk for the 2023-06 to 2025-05 history window. Owned by Retail Operations; catalog last refreshed 2025-03-31.

schema.notes: Catalog lists 3 columns; no legacy code column and no effective-dating fields.

spatial.code_system: free-text product names and internal product codes
spatial.notes: No geography field; the store's location is not recorded in this table. Geography is not applicable to a product master.

access.request_process: Open to analytics roles (catalog entry internal.sales.products). Not probed.

documentation_excerpts: Current product codes, names and categories. (catalog description)
From 2024-04-01, product codes changed. Codes ending in "L" were replaced by new codes. (wiki product_codes_2024)
No mapping table exists between the old and new codes. (wiki product_codes_2024)
Old and new codes can only be matched by product name, and some names are not unique. (wiki product_codes_2024)
`sales.products` lists only the current codes. (wiki product_codes_2024)
quality_notes: Does not meet N2 on its own: it lists only current codes, and the wiki states no old-to-new mapping table exists (wiki product_codes_2024, last_edited 2024-04-02).

Staleness: catalog last_refreshed 2025-03-31 with refresh 'on change', while the as_of date is 2026-10-15 and the recent window runs to 2026-03-31. Any product changes after 2025-03-31 may be missing; the catalog does not say whether it has changed since.

Wiki product_codes_2024 (last_edited 2024-04-02) is older than the catalog (last_refreshed 2025-03-31). The wiki gives no information on post-2024 changes, so the two sources do not conflict but cannot confirm currency.
Name matching is ambiguous: wiki product_codes_2024 says some product names are not unique, so a name-based crosswalk needs manual review.
Catalog temporal_coverage is null/null, so the period the table describes is not documented.
Catalog says 'Current product codes' while the wiki says the codes changed on 2024-04-01; it is not documented whether the table holds only post-change codes or whether earlier rows were removed.
Sample not taken: no data sample was requested for this internal table, and the access route was not probed.
